limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also advanced both Gray pointers a cycle earlier, changing full and empty timing, and added reset gating to the RAM enables that the reference did not have.
The test checked ordering using the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers counted and checked full and empty only after settling, so it could pass despite the changed cycle-by-cycle flag timing.
